svg.title: GATHER - Interchangeable Welcome Home Sign
svg.desc: Size 8.00 x 2.75 in (203.2 x 69.85 mm). 1 unit = 1 mm. RED = cut (all closed paths, text converted to outlines). BLUE = optional score/engrave border (do not cut through). Personal and small-batch physical sales only - do not share or resell this file.
